### Non-obvious Logic

1. **"Person 2 of 9" navigation:** The backend must pass the current list context (smart list ID, filters, sort order) alongside the person detail fetch so ← → can jump to prev/next. Typically implemented as a cursor-based position in the list result set stored in session or URL params (e.g. `?listId=X&position=2`).

2. **Campaign email "archived" body:** Automation emails that are sent via a campaign drip show the word "archived" as the body text in the timeline — this likely means the email campaign log entry stores "archived" as a status, and the full email content is accessed via "View campaign email" link. The tracking URL with `_pxl=` is FUB's pixel tracking parameter for open-rate counting.

3. **"2 opens" badge:** Computed from pixel-fire events stored server-side; displayed as a colored pill on email timeline events. Green color at any opens count.

4. **Overdue task styling:** Tasks where `due_at < NOW()` and `status != 'completed'` render the date in orange/amber. No red used — amber is the overdue signal.

5. **Phone number "warming up" banner:** FUB provisions a local phone number per account for SMS. During the provisioning/warming period (newly registered numbers need to warm up for SMS carrier acceptance), a banner is shown in the texting UI path. The "Try out texting" CTA redirects to the texting module even before the number is fully warm, likely for testing UI.

6. **Automation pause icon:** Renders only when automation `status === 'running'`; a "resume" icon would render when paused.

7. **"Seen 17 days ago":** This is the FUB website tracking (pixel-based visit tracking) — the contact last visited the agent's tracked website 17 days ago. Separate from "Last Communication 16 days ago" (which is last email/call/text event in the timeline).

8. **Custom fields:** These appear to be account-level custom fields applied to all contacts (not per-record). All 18 fields are likely empty for this contact; the enrichment fields (Enrichment Provider, Phone Type, Owner Age, etc.) suggest this account uses a third-party data enrichment service that populates these fields when available.

9. **AgentFire FUB Widget:** This is a third-party integration panel injected via FUB's widget/integration system. It shows AgentFire (a real estate website builder) activity for this contact. Collapsed by default here.

10. **Files drag-and-drop:** The "drag some here" text implies the files section is a drag target — the whole panel should have `dragover` / `drop` event handlers to initiate file upload without clicking "+".

11. **Timeline event dropdown "Matt Ryan → Laurie McAdam ▾":** The "▾" dropdown on each event likely shows: Edit, Delete, Forward, Mark as Starred — standard event actions.

12. **"Include In FB CAS":** Custom field suggesting Facebook Custom Audience Sync — this field controls whether the contact's data is synced to a Facebook custom audience for ad targeting. Boolean field type expected.
